sample.title: Sample report
sample.listDescription: With Premium, reports from your own to-dos stack up like this every week and month
sample.noticeDescription: Subscribe and we'll analyze your own to-dos like this every week and month

summaries.lastWeek: You left 2 of 4 on Wednesday, then cleared every to-do three days straight from Friday to Sunday. You finished the most around 7 AM and got 13 of 14 work to-dos done. Workouts slipped the most, with 4 of 8 done.
summaries.twoWeeksAgo: You left one or two each weekday but cleared everything on Sunday. Finishing 5 of 6 on Friday gave the week a strong finish. You got 4 of 8 workouts done.
summaries.threeWeeksAgo: You planned 6 on Friday and left half, but cleared everything over the weekend. You got 12 of 14 work to-dos done. Workouts slipped the most, with 3 of 8 done.
summaries.fourWeeksAgo: Finishing 3 of 4 on Wednesday got you through midweek. You cleared everything on Sunday and got 12 of 14 work to-dos done. Study slipped a little, with 6 of 10 done.

tips.workout: Put your workout right after your 7 AM to-do so it slips less.
tips.midweek: Midweek, try keeping it to four to-dos or fewer.

summaries.lastMonth: You cleared every to-do over the last 5 days of the month to finish strong. You finished the most around 7 AM and kept up with work steadily. Workouts had the lowest completion rate.
summaries.twoMonthsAgo: The earlier you started with a to-do, the more you got done that day. You cleared every to-do over the last 2 days of the month. Workouts had the lowest completion rate.
summaries.threeMonthsAgo: You kept up with work steadily and cleared every to-do over the last 3 days of the month. You finished the most around 7 AM. Study slipped more often than work, and workouts had the lowest completion rate.
summaries.fourMonthsAgo: You kept weekends light at 3 to-dos a day and did most of it on weekdays. You finished the most around 7 AM and cleared everything on the last day of the month. Workouts had the lowest completion rate.

tips.repeat: Make your workout a repeating to-do with a set day and time.
tips.morning: Next month, try finishing one work to-do first thing in the morning.
